properties.text: Total ether must be conserved across move_ether: sender debit equals recipient credit.
properties.assertion: forall move_ether(s,r,amt): bal(s)_pre - bal(s)_post == bal(r)_post - bal(r)_pre == amt

properties.text: move_ether must revert if sender balance is less than transfer amount.
properties.assertion: forall move_ether(s,r,amt): s.balance < amt => revert(AssertionError)

properties.text: Rollback must restore state trie and transient storage to pre-transaction snapshot.
properties.assertion: forall rollback_tx(st): st._main_trie == snapshot_trie AND st.transient == snapshot_transient

properties.text: begin_transaction must create deep copies so mutations do not corrupt snapshot.
properties.assertion: forall begin_tx(st): snapshot_trie is deepcopy(st._main_trie) AND id(snapshot) != id(current)

properties.text: State root must incorporate all storage roots; missing storage root corrupts block hash.
properties.assertion: state_root(st) == root(main_trie, get_storage_root=lambda a: storage_root(st,a))

properties.text: Transaction gas must be >= max(intrinsic_gas, calldata_floor) per EIP-7623/7825.
properties.assertion: forall tx: tx.gas >= max(intrinsic_gas(tx), calldata_floor(tx)) AND tx.gas <= TX_MAX_GAS_LIMIT

properties.text: TX_MAX_GAS_LIMIT (16777216) must be enforced; exceeding it must raise error.
properties.assertion: forall tx: tx.gas > 16777216 => raise TransactionGasLimitExceededError

properties.text: Signature r must satisfy 0 < r < SECP256K1N; s must satisfy 0 < s <= SECP256K1N/2.
properties.assertion: forall tx: 0 < tx.r < SECP256K1N AND 0 < tx.s <= SECP256K1N/2

properties.text: decode_transaction must be the inverse of encode_transaction for all valid types.
properties.assertion: forall tx: decode_transaction(encode_transaction(tx)) == tx

properties.text: Empty accounts (nonce=0, code=b'', balance=0) must be auto-destroyed via modify_state.
properties.assertion: forall modify_state(st,addr,f): post_acct.nonce==0 AND post_acct.code==b'' AND post_acct.balance==0 => destroyed

properties.text: set_storage must assert account exists before modifying storage trie.
properties.assertion: forall set_storage(st,addr,k,v): trie_get(st._main_trie, addr) is not None

properties.text: Nonce must increment by exactly 1 and be monotonically increasing per account.
properties.assertion: forall increment_nonce(st,addr): post_nonce == pre_nonce + 1

properties.text: Nonce must not overflow U64.MAX_VALUE; transactions with nonce >= U64.MAX must be rejected.
properties.assertion: forall tx: U256(tx.nonce) >= U256(U64.MAX_VALUE) => raise NonceOverflowError

properties.text: Contract creation must reject initcode exceeding MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE.
properties.assertion: forall tx: tx.to==Bytes0 AND len(tx.data)>MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE => raise InitCodeTooLargeError

properties.text: Unknown transaction type prefix must raise TransactionTypeError in decode.
properties.assertion: forall tx_bytes: tx_bytes[0] not in {1,2,3,4} AND isinstance(tx_bytes,Bytes) => raise TransactionTypeError

properties.text: Each signing hash function must include its type prefix to prevent cross-type replay.
properties.assertion: forall typed_tx: signing_hash(tx) == keccak256(type_byte ++ rlp.encode(fields))

properties.text: EIP-155 signing hash must include chain_id to prevent cross-chain replay attacks.
properties.assertion: signing_hash_155(tx) == keccak256(rlp(nonce,gas_price,gas,to,value,data,chain_id,0,0))

properties.text: commit_transaction must clear created_accounts only when popping the last snapshot.
properties.assertion: forall commit_tx(st): len(st._snapshots)==0 => st.created_accounts == empty_set

properties.text: get_storage_original must return U256(0) for newly created accounts regardless of current storage.
properties.assertion: forall get_storage_original(st,addr,key): addr in st.created_accounts => result == U256(0)

properties.text: Transient storage must be scoped to a single transaction and cleared on commit/rollback.
properties.assertion: forall tx_boundary: transient_storage_post == empty OR restored_from_snapshot

properties.text: destroy_account must remove both account entry and its storage trie atomically.
properties.assertion: forall destroy_account(st,addr): post(trie_get(st._main_trie,addr))==None AND addr not in st._storage_tries

properties.text: state_root and storage_root must not be computed during an active transaction.
properties.assertion: forall state_root(st): len(st._snapshots) == 0

properties.text: P2P peers are untrusted; all P2P-received transactions must be fully validated before state changes.
properties.assertion: forall p2p_tx: validate_transaction(tx) called before any state mutation

properties.text: Engine API is JWT-authenticated; unauthenticated callers must not trigger state transitions.
properties.assertion: forall engine_api_call(caller,payload): caller.hasValidJWT == true

properties.text: EIP-4844 signing hash must bind blob_versioned_hashes and max_fee_per_blob_gas to signature.
properties.assertion: signing_hash_4844(tx) commits to (blob_versioned_hashes, max_fee_per_blob_gas)

properties.text: EIP-7702 signing hash must bind authorizations list to signature to prevent delegation tampering.
properties.assertion: signing_hash_7702(tx) commits to authorizations field

properties.text: Calldata floor cost per EIP-7623 must enforce tokens*FLOOR_CALLDATA_COST + TX_BASE_COST.
properties.assertion: calldata_floor == (zero_bytes + (len(data)-zero_bytes)*4) * FLOOR_CALLDATA_COST + TX_BASE_COST

properties.text: EIP-7702 SetCodeTransaction auth cost must be PER_EMPTY_ACCOUNT_COST * len(authorizations).
properties.assertion: forall SetCodeTx: auth_cost == PER_EMPTY_ACCOUNT_COST * len(tx.authorizations)

properties.text: set_storage must clean up empty storage tries to prevent state bloat.
properties.assertion: forall set_storage(st,addr,k,v): trie._data=={} => addr not in st._storage_tries

properties.text: get_account must never return None; must return EMPTY_ACCOUNT for non-existent addresses.
properties.assertion: forall get_account(st,addr): result is not None AND isinstance(result, Account)

properties.text: get_storage must return U256(0) for unset keys; return type must always be U256.
properties.assertion: forall get_storage(st,addr,key): (trie is None => result==U256(0)) AND isinstance(result,U256)

properties.text: begin_transaction must increase snapshot count by exactly 1.
properties.assertion: forall begin_tx(st): len(st._snapshots)_post == len(st._snapshots)_pre + 1

properties.text: close_state must release all state references: _main_trie, _storage_tries, _snapshots, created_accounts.
properties.assertion: forall close_state(st): all refs (_main_trie, _storage_tries, _snapshots, created_accounts) deleted

properties.text: is_account_alive must return true only if account exists and differs from EMPTY_ACCOUNT.
properties.assertion: forall is_account_alive(st,addr): result == (acct is not None AND acct != EMPTY_ACCOUNT)

properties.text: Transaction type prefix bytes must be unique (0x01-0x04); collision enables type confusion attacks.
properties.assertion: type_prefixes == {AccessList:0x01, FeeMarket:0x02, Blob:0x03, SetCode:0x04} AND all_unique

properties.text: Legacy transaction hash must RLP-encode before keccak256; typed tx hash includes type prefix.
properties.assertion: forall get_tx_hash(tx): legacy => keccak256(rlp(tx)); typed => keccak256(encoded_with_prefix)

properties.text: Pre-EIP-155 signing hash must not include chain_id (backwards compatibility).
properties.assertion: signing_hash_pre155(tx) == keccak256(rlp(nonce,gas_price,gas,to,value,data))

properties.text: mark_account_created persists across reverts; used by get_storage_original and EIP-6780.
properties.assertion: forall mark_account_created(st,addr): addr in st.created_accounts until outer commit

properties.text: Optimized intrinsic cost calculation must produce same accept/reject as unoptimized byte iteration.
properties.assertion: forall tx: optimized_intrinsic_cost(tx) == reference_intrinsic_cost(tx)

properties.text: Optimized signature recovery must produce same sender address as reference secp256k1_recover.
properties.assertion: forall tx: optimized_recover_sender(tx) == reference_recover_sender(tx)

properties.text: Optimized state root computation must produce same root hash as reference trie traversal.
properties.assertion: forall st: optimized_state_root(st) == reference_state_root(st)

properties.text: Optimized RLP decode must reject same invalid inputs as reference decoder; no silent acceptance.
properties.assertion: forall bytes: optimized_decode(bytes).error iff reference_decode(bytes).error

properties.text: Malformed RLP/SSZ transaction bytes from P2P must not cause unbounded deserialization cost.
properties.assertion: forall p2p_tx_bytes: decode_cost(tx_bytes) <= MAX_DECODE_COST_BOUND

properties.text: Attacker-crafted transactions must not manipulate state trie to cause excessive recomputation.
properties.assertion: forall tx: state_recomputation_cost(tx) <= O(log(N)) per trie operation

properties.text: Replayed signed messages from different fork/epoch must be rejected by signature verification.
properties.assertion: forall signed_msg: signing_hash includes chain_id OR v encodes chain_id => no cross-chain replay

properties.text: set_account_balance sets exact amount; no addition/subtraction that could overflow.
properties.assertion: forall set_account_balance(st,addr,amt): get_account(st,addr).balance == amt
